interpretation: Holding the DeepSeek model family and frozen event population approximately constant, changing the measurement contract produces a very large label shift.
This is not inter-rater disagreement because the comparison intentionally reuses the same model family under a revised measurement system.
The transition does not prove every v1 positive was false: rubric definitions, packet design, prompts, and provider-side execution context all changed between v1 and v2.
The result strongly supports treating semantic operationalization as an empirical measurement variable rather than assuming a bias label is observer-invariant.
v1 C positives mostly collapse into no epistemic promotion; v1 P positives collapse into necessary decomposition/original-goal work; v1 R positives collapse into normal non-rework or correction.
Independent Reviewer-v2 replication is required before the zero-positive v2 result is treated as semantic consensus.
